providerConvention: queryUom passes each complete feature, including its interior rings, into flyLayer; interior rings are additionally drawn in controlLayer. Layer labels identify suitable-flight reference and internal control reference.
interpretation: allow polygons with their holes excluded
scope: Selected third-party snapshot semantics; does not verify official regulatory permission, height, currency, completeness or independent alignment.
geometryReview: Ring reversal/rotation only; exact coordinates, feature properties/IDs, ring/component counts and topology independently audited with GEOS. Conservative contact and work-budget findings retained. No repair or dropping.
